newsitem.title: UK: Lavendon seeks to raise 8-12 mln stg with issue.
newsitem.headline: Lavendon seeks to raise 8-12 mln stg with issue.

text.p: Lavendon Group Plc, the UK power access equipment fleet operator, said on Wednesday it plans to issue new shares this Autumn to try to raise between eight million and 12 million stg. "We are expecting to issue the shares in Autumn this year," Lavendon chairman David Price said.
The company said its proposed flotation on the Official List would give it flexibility to take advantage of expected growth on UK and German powered access rental markets.
Lavendon said it earned 975,000 stg in the first half of this year on turnover of 5.4 million stg.
Lavendon rents powered access equipment, including scissor lifts and vehicle mounted platforms, which provide temporary aerial access for workers.
